selection: All six M16 verified train dates, including startup abstentions
geometry: camRect0; boxes from rotation-only projected RGB, finite-depth parallax unresolved
association: Current track endpoint in half-open xyxy box; overlaps explicitly shared; no object detections or IoU metric
depth: S01 stereo recomputed at previous timestamp, never GT; no stale-depth reuse
temporal_limit: 50 ms causal windows shifted 20 ms, overlap 30 ms; insufficient history remains unknown
annotation_policy: Reference boxes used only after model estimation; not used to seed tracks or select camera inliers
quality: Support diagnostic on train, not object precision/recall; unlabeled area is not verified static background
